title: Pre-registered predictions of the sign of ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) on the 7 TEST datasets, from the DEV statistics S1_lodo (frozen I7-1 rule) and S3
status: written before any TEST curve is loaded, simulated or fitted. The final TEST run is planned for about 2026-12-10

test_data_not_opened.statement: TEST data were not opened. The only TEST information used is the tag lists in the split files (device names), which carry no measured or simulated values
test_data_not_opened.verification: every record loaded by this script is checked to be in the DEV list and not in the TEST list of its split file (records_DEV_only below); the record directories read are the I7-1 retro DEV record paths; files_read lists every file this script opened

frozen_rule.form: predicted y_D = a + b * S1_lodo_D; predicted sign of ln GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) = sign(a + b * S1_lodo_D); predicted gain iff a + b * S1_lodo_D < 0
frozen_rule.fit: OLS over the 11 stored datasets (dataset level), retro/results.json
frozen_rule.slope_sign_note: b < 0: higher S1_lodo predicts a lower log ratio (more gain)

S3_rule: predicted gain (negative ln GMR) iff S3 < 0; S3 = stored dataset-level value (retro/s3.json per-fold values, weighted by held-out devices per fold), reduced M_bias recipe (1 seed, 500 steps)
statistic_definition_used: primary: the stored dataset-level DEV values of out/research/explore/I7_1/retro/results.json (mean over the DEV leave-one-out folds of the statistic on each fold's training devices; the definition the frozen rule was fit on). Secondary (reported, not the prediction): S1_lodo on the TEST run's training set (all DEV devices; IHP per class)

sky130.C0_refit: held-out card refit of each TEST device without correction from its starting card: ngspice_fit.polish, max_nfev 400, irls_rounds 2, diff_step 0.01 (I3-2 settings), same parameter box as the dataset's DEV runs
sky130.M_bias: I3-2 recipe unchanged (cryoml.explore.i3_2_bias.fit_bias, 'M_bias'): I = I_card * exp(g), g = tanh(h(x)), h = MLP 3-16-16-1 (tanh hidden, last layer zero-initialized), x = (is_pmos 0/1, |Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD) with the two bias inputs standardized by the training-point mean/std; loss = mean over training devices of the paper per-device RRMS of the corrected current + 1e-4 * sum of squared weight-matrix entries; Adam lr 3e-3, 2000 full-batch steps, float64, seeds 0-4, g = mean of the 5 members. Trained post hoc on the starting-card records of the training set below, frozen; each TEST card is refit with g in the loop (same polish settings as C0_refit), the best card re-simulated, corrected with the same g and scored
sky130.score: strict paper RRMS per device (e1_correction.score_device: mean over the frozen measured-inclusion curves of trimmed RMSE / trimmed mean |I_measured|)
sky130.outcome: y = mean over TEST devices of ln(RRMS_M_bias / RRMS_C0_refit); GMR(M_bias, C0_refit) = exp(y) (i3_2_bias.paired_ratio; devices with a non-finite or non-positive RRMS in either arm left out and counted). Predicted sign correct iff sign(predicted y) = sign(y)
sky130.code_status: no TEST mode exists in the code at this commit; the protocol is the TEST_policy / method-freeze text of the dataset's prereg, restated here
sky130.source: out/research/explore/real_split.json REAL_TEST (6 devices, 3 nMOS, 3 pMOS); I3-2 prereg data_reuse_note (REAL_TEST at the method freeze, configuration fixed before loading)
sky130.starting_cards: the 43-parameter direct-fit cards in out/research/polished/direct43_r3_fd/real/summary.json (as for REAL_DEV); records by scripts/research/explore/e1_collect_real.py --split test (one NGSpice run per device)
sky130.training_set: all 12 REAL_DEV starting-card records (out/research/explore/E1/real_dev), both polarities, one M_bias ensemble

evaluation_at_TEST.summary: number of correct signs out of 7 for each statistic. The 4 IHP temperatures share DUTs and the 2 TU Delft temperatures share devices; the 7 outcomes are not independent (3 device sets)
evaluation_at_TEST.no_change: these predictions, the rule and the protocol are not changed after this file is committed; a change gets a dated amendment
